the azimuthal decorrelation between Mueller-Navelet jet events is sensitive to the next-to-leading order logarithmic corrections, and can therefore be used to determine the value of the strong coupling at next-to-next-to-leading logarithmic accuracy.

the azimuthal decorrelation of the jets is a very good testing ground for the NLL corrections to the Balitsky-Kuraev-Lipaev-Lipatova evolution equations and the renormalization group improvement of the NLL kernels.
